notes: The tutorial offers a potentiometer or a photoresistor + 10K resistor; I built the potentiometer version, which the circuit text describes: GND to one outer pin, 5V to the other outer pin, A0 to the middle pin.

Breadboard holes follow the catalogue naming (bank 't' = rows a-e). The pot sits in columns 10, 11, 12 of row e (GND, SIG, VCC), with wires in the same columns of row a. The image's row labelling differs, but the electrical connections are the same.

The optional external LED circuit is included: pin 13 -> wire4 -> 220 ohm resistor -> LED anode; LED cathode -> wire5 -> GND (GND.3, the GND next to pin 13). The LED's position and the wire4/wire5 colours are my assumption; the tutorial gives no image for this circuit.
The pot's GND wire uses GND.2 on the power header, as in the image.
The photoresistor circuit (image 2) is not built.
